q1_issues.issue: The coordinated objects "the oppressor as well as the oppressed" are collapsed into ONE defeat event carrying two Theme atoms, but coordinated NPs are distributive by default (one event per conjunct) and the collective one-event form is licensed only for reciprocal/aggregate predicates or bare "together/jointly" — neither of which "defeat" is.

q2_gaps: a comma-set participial adjunct on the subject read as a conditional restriction ("Power, wrongly used, defeats …" = "when wrongly used"): the reduced-relative rule covers attributive participles on a noun, but not this adverbial/conditional use nor its promotion into a rule premise
"as well as" as an additive coordinator — only plain "X and Y" coordination is specified, and the additive/scalar contribution ("even the oppressor") has no carrier
notes: The generic-rule routing, the reduced-relative use event with surface-form (Manner … wrongly), Agent on the inanimate transitive subject, bare class symbols for the generic objects, and the 0.9/0.9 empirical generic TV are all as instructed.
